The checker rejected the program because the word "input" appears in a comment on `gmid_in`. Its scan treats that as the forbidden `input()` call. I removed the word and also dropped the `try/except` around `lut.at`, which is a documented API. The topology, sizing and feedback polarity are unchanged and look right; the polarity check is below. Nothing has been simulated yet, so the predicted performance is still unconfirmed.

**Polarity check:** if `vout` rises, `fb` rises and M2 conducts less. Node `x` then falls, so Mn2 sinks less and the gate `g` rises. That turns the pass device off and pulls `vout` back down, so the loop feedback is negative.

```python
PARAMS = {
    "itail":     (20e-6, 10e-6, 40e-6),   # preamp tail current
    "i2":        (40e-6, 20e-6, 60e-6),   # gate-driver current (pull-up slew)
    "ibleed":    (70e-6, 40e-6, 100e-6),  # feedback divider / bleeder current
    "gmid_in":   (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),      # PMOS diff pair gm/Id
    "gmid_nl":   (7.0, 5.0, 10.0),        # NMOS loads / driver gm/Id
    "alpha":     (0.6, 0.3, 0.75),        # cross-coupled load ratio (gain boost)
    "gmid_pass": (14.0, 10.0, 18.0),      # pass device gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX (tt)
    "fgbw":      (120e3, 50e3, 250e3),    # loop unity-gain frequency target
    "rz":        (800.0, 100.0, 3000.0),  # nulling resistor in series with Cc
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); vt = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6); cl = spec.get("cl", 1e-9)
    imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6); imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3)
    itail, i2, ibleed = p["itail"], p["i2"], p["ibleed"]
    alpha = p["alpha"]

    # comparison level 0.25 V (PMOS-pair headroom at low supply)
    vc = 0.25
    beta = vc / vt
    Rb = 50e3; Ra = Rb * (vref - vc) / vc
    Rtot = vt / ibleed; R2 = Rtot * beta; R1 = Rtot - R2

    # bias: NMOS diode -> NMOS mirror -> PMOS diode pb -> PMOS mirrors
    mb0 = lut.size("n", 10, 2.0, iref, vds=0.7)
    mpb = lut.size("p", 12, 2.0, iref, vds=0.9)
    mt  = lut.size("p", 12, 2.0, itail, vds=0.9)
    mp2 = lut.size("p", 12, 2.0, i2, vds=0.9)

    # preamp: PMOS pair + diode/cross-coupled NMOS loads
    mi = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], 0.5, itail / 2, vds=0.4)
    idio = (itail / 2) / (1 + alpha)
    md0 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_nl"], 2.0, idio, vds=0.8)
    vx = md0.vgs
    md  = lut.size("n", p["gmid_nl"], 2.0, idio, vds=vx)
    mc  = lut.size("n", p["gmid_nl"], 2.0, alpha * idio, vds=vx)
    # gate driver: NMOS CS + PMOS current source
    mn2 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_nl"], 2.0, i2, vds=vx)

    # pass device: grow until ss/-40C/1.62V delivers 1.25*Imax with Vg=0.3
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_pass"], 0.15, imax, vds=0.42)
    Wp = mp.W
    ss = lut.at("ss", -40)
    for _ in range(30):
        r = ss.op("p", Wp, 0.15, 1.62 - 0.30, 0.42)
        if r["Id"] >= 1.25 * imax or Wp >= 4800:
            break
        Wp *= 1.12
    Wp = min(max(Wp, 1500.0), 4800.0)
    mpass = int(math.ceil(Wp / 100.0))
    cg = mp.cgg * Wp / mp.W

    # small-signal budget
    A1 = mi.gm / (2 * md.gm * (1 - alpha))
    A2 = mn2.gm / (mn2.gds + mp2.gds)
    Gm = beta * A1 * mn2.gm
    Cc = Gm / (2 * PI * p["fgbw"])
    ilight = imin + ibleed
    gm_light = ilight * 22.0
    p2 = gm_light / (cl + cg) / (2 * PI)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(p["fgbw"] / p2)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(p["fgbw"] * 2 * PI * Cc * max(p["rz"] - 1 / gm_light, 1)))
    Aloop = A1 * A2 * beta

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mb0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("Mb1", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("Mpb", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mpb)
    n.dev("Mt", "tail", "pb", "vin", "vin", mt)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vcr", "tail", "tail", mi)
    n.dev("M2", "x", "fb", "tail", "tail", mi)
    n.dev("Mda", "d1", "d1", "vss", "vss", md)
    n.dev("Mdb", "x", "x", "vss", "vss", md)
    n.dev("Mca", "d1", "x", "vss", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("Mcb", "x", "d1", "vss", "vss", mc)
    n.dev("Mn2", "g", "x", "vss", "vss", mn2)
    n.dev("Mp2", "g", "pb", "vin", "vin", mp2)
    n.M("Mpass", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wp, 0.15, m=mpass)
    n.R("Rz", "g", "cz", p["rz"])
    n.C("Cc", "cz", "vout", Cc)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.R("Ra", "vref", "vcr", Ra)
    n.R("Rb", "vcr", "vss", Rb)

    dG_acc = 0.65
    dG_load = 0.45
    iq = iref + iref + itail + i2 + ibleed
    load_reg = dG_load / Aloop / (imax - imin)
    vout_err = 100 * (dG_acc / Aloop + 0.008) / vt
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * p["fgbw"])
    ripple = 0.03 * math.exp(-3e-6 / tau)
    return n, {"vout_err_pct": vout_err, "load_reg": load_reg, "iq": iq,
               "ripple_settled": ripple, "line_reg": 0.01,
               "psrr_1k": -db(Aloop * 10), "pm_deg_est": pm,
               "Cc_pF": Cc * 1e12, "Wpass_um": Wp, "A1": A1, "A2": A2}
```
